information: This competition takes place on a **Friday Evening** and will only feature ***Fewest Moves and 7x7x7.*** This competition is not recommended for newcomers. If this would be your first competition, we recommend looking at other competitions in [Ohio.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
